'''Paul Todd Feldman Mind What You Are Told''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Paul Todd Feldman]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/Hiding.html Paul Todd Feldman's Mind What You Are Told!], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000304034229/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/Hiding.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Feldman LS MWYHL Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
Feldman's [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]] deck replaced his Hiding in the Clouds deck on the same page. Two cards are listed as the site gives them: "Coreillan Freighter Captain" and "Hoth: Control Room" match no card title.<ref name="torch" />
